subject: Commercial Zoning Framework and ADU Ordinance Updates
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met to discuss citywide zoning ordinance updates, focusing on a high-level introduction to the proposed commercial zoning framework and revisions to the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) ordinance in response to state law.

items.title: Commercial Zoning Framework
items.summary: Paula Ramos Martinez of Innes Associates presented a high-level overview of the proposed citywide commercial zoning framework, which classifies commercial areas into three mixed-use sub-districts. No votes were taken, and the consultants will revise the commercial map based on committee and public feedback regarding density in Medford Square and West Medford.

items.title: Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Ordinance Updates
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed updates to the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) ordinance to comply with new state mandates and discussed options for local discretionary regulations. No votes were taken, but the committee expressed support for allowing ADUs in all residential districts with certain restrictions, using the Community Development Board for special permits, and prohibiting short-term rentals of ADUs.

items.title: Upcoming Zoning Project Timeline
items.summary: The committee and consultants reviewed the projected schedule of zoning update topics through June 2025.
